title: Can Multimodal LLMs Perform Time Series Anomaly Detection?

claim.summary: The study compares anomaly granularity and input modalities, then builds TSAD-Agents with scanning, planning, detection and checking roles.

modules.name: Anomaly granularity and modality evaluation
modules.scope_reason: Point/range/variate and irregular-input protocols directly evaluate anomaly detection.

modules.name: Anomaly-type-aware detector routing and refinement
modules.scope_reason: Scanning selects anomaly type, planning selects detector modality/tools, and checking revises anomaly boundaries.
